components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: Stacked headings that each show or hide a section.
a11y: Each trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Enter and Space toggle; Arrow keys, Home and End move between triggers.
single or multiple open items; collapsible lets the last one close.

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: A message that stays on screen, with a title and a tone.
a11y: danger and warning are role=alert and announced at once; info and success are role=status and polite.
The title always states the meaning in words; colour is not the only signal.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert dialog
components.description: A modal that interrupts to confirm a destructive or irreversible action.
a11y: role="alertdialog" with a name from the title and a description.
Focus moves to the Cancel button on open and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape cancels; focus is trapped; the page behind is inert.
Clicking the overlay does not close it.

components.name: animated-list
components.title: Animated list
components.description: A list whose items enter one by one without shifting the layout.
a11y: A real <ul> with <li> items, so list semantics and counts are announced.
Items fade in with opacity only and keep their space from the first frame; there is no layout shift.
With prefers-reduced-motion all items are visible at once.

components.name: area-chart
components.title: Area chart
components.description: A line chart filled down to zero, optionally stacked to show a running total.
a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every value, one row per category, for screen readers.
One focusable stop per category with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus; stacked charts also show the total.
Series differ by fill pattern and dash as well as colour, and the legend names them.
No entrance animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.title: Aspect ratio
components.description: Keep media or a placeholder at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
a11y: A plain div; the content keeps its own semantics and alt text.

components.name: autocomplete
components.title: Autocomplete
components.description: A text field that suggests values while you type and accepts anything you enter.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through suggestions, Enter picks the active one (or keeps typed text), Escape closes.
The field value is always the typed or picked text; nothing is forced to match a suggestion.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: A person or thing as an image with an initials fallback.
a11y: name is required: it is the image alt text and the fallback's accessible name.
The fallback shows while the image loads or if it fails.

components.name: avatar-group
components.title: Avatar group
components.description: Overlap several avatars and show how many more there are.
a11y: role="group" with an accessible name; the overflow count is plain text.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: A short status word or count.
a11y: Plain text in a span; the word carries the meaning, not the colour.
For a count that changes, put it inside an aria-live region yourself.

components.name: bar-chart
components.title: Bar chart
components.description: Compare values across categories with vertical or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked.
a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every value, one row per category, for screen readers.
One focusable stop per category with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus.
Series differ by fill pattern as well as colour, and the legend names them.
No entrance animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: bento-grid
components.title: Bento grid
components.description: A responsive asymmetric grid of cards with column and row spans.
a11y: Plain divs in source order, so reading and tab order match the visual order on phones and follow the DOM elsewhere.
Spans collapse to a single column on narrow screens; nothing depends on colour or motion.

components.name: block-cta
components.title: Call to action block
components.description: A closing call to action with one sentence and one next step.
a11y: A section named by its title; actions are ordinary buttons or links.

components.name: block-dashboard-shell
components.title: Dashboard shell block
components.description: App frame with sidebar, top bar and content that collapses to a drawer on small screens.
a11y: The sidebar and the drawer hold the same navigation landmark, named by navLabel; the current page has aria-current="page".
Below 800px the sidebar is hidden and a Menu button opens a left drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
Choosing a link closes the drawer. The content is a main landmark; put one h1 in it.

components.name: block-empty-page
components.title: Empty page block
components.description: A full-page message for not found, nothing yet or no access.
a11y: A section named by its title, with the title as the page heading.
The large code is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

components.name: block-feature-grid
components.title: Feature grid block
components.description: A section title above a responsive grid of short features.
a11y: A section named by its title; features are a list of items.
Feature titles are headings one level below the section title, so the outline stays in order.

components.name: block-footer
components.title: Footer block
components.description: A site footer with brand, link columns and small print.
a11y: A footer element: the page contentinfo landmark. Use one per page.
Each link column is a nav named by its title, with a heading at the chosen level.

components.name: block-hero
components.title: Hero block
components.description: A page opener with eyebrow, title, description, actions and optional media.
a11y: A section named by its title through aria-labelledby.
The title is a real heading; headingLevel sets the outline level (h1 by default).
Media is passed in: give images alt text.

components.name: block-login
components.title: Login block
components.description: Email and password sign-in form with validation messages.
a11y: A section named by its title; the form is named by the same heading.
Invalid submits show a role=alert summary whose links move focus to each field, and each field gets aria-invalid and an error message.
Email and password carry autocomplete hints for password managers.

components.name: block-pricing
components.title: Pricing block
components.description: Plan cards with a monthly and yearly switch.
a11y: A section named by its title; plans are a list, each with a heading one level below the title.
The billing switch is a named radio group operable with arrow keys.
Prices are plain text next to their period, never colour alone; the popular plan carries a text badge.

components.name: block-settings-form
components.title: Settings form block
components.description: Settings sections of switches and selects, each in a fieldset.
a11y: Each section is a fieldset with a legend, so grouped controls are announced with it.
Switches have role=switch with visible labels; hints are linked with aria-describedby.
Selects are native and labelled.

components.name: block-signup
components.title: Sign-up block
components.description: Name, email and password account form with validation messages.
a11y: A section named by its title; the form is named by the same heading.
Invalid submits show a role=alert summary whose links move focus to each field, and each field gets aria-invalid and an error message.
The password hint states the minimum length; autocomplete hints are set.

components.name: block-testimonials
components.title: Testimonials block
components.description: Quotes with their authors, as figures with blockquotes.
a11y: Each quote is a figure with a blockquote and a figcaption.
Avatars are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

components.name: border-beam
components.title: Border beam
components.description: A thin bordered box with a light that travels around its edge. CSS only.
a11y: The beam is aria-hidden and decorative; the content keeps its normal reading order.
The beam is hidden under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving a plain thin border.

components.name: box
components.title: Box
components.description: A div with padding and a thin border mapped to the spacing tokens.
a11y: A plain element; adds no roles. Use asChild to render a landmark such as section.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: The path to the current page.
a11y: A nav landmark with an aria-label, containing an ordered list.
The current page has aria-current=page and is not a link.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants.
a11y: Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses.
loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks while keeping the label.
asChild renders a link without losing link semantics.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button group
components.description: Join related buttons into one segmented bar.
a11y: role="group" with a required accessible name.

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: A month grid for picking one date.
a11y: role="grid" with column headers; one day is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
Arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the start and end of the week, PageUp/PageDown by month.
Each day button has a full date name; the selected day has aria-pressed and today has aria-current="date".

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: A bordered group for one thing you can pick up or open.
a11y: Plain divs and a heading; no roles added.
With asChild on a link or button the whole card is one keyboard-focusable control.

components.name: carousel
components.title: Carousel
components.description: A row of slides you scroll or step through with buttons.
a11y: A named region with aria-roledescription="carousel"; each slide is a group named "N of M".
Previous and Next are real buttons; the track is also scrollable by keyboard and touch.
No auto-play, so nothing moves without the user.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A box to turn one choice on or off, with an indeterminate state.
a11y: role=checkbox; Space toggles; Tab focuses.
indeterminate is exposed as aria-checked=mixed.
A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.

components.name: code-block
components.title: Code block
components.description: A block of code with a copy button.
a11y: The code is a pre/code element; the region has an accessible name.
The copy button is announced as "Copy code" and confirms with a polite live message.

components.name: collapsible
components.title: Collapsible
components.description: Show or hide one region of content from a trigger.
a11y: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Space and Enter toggle it.

components.name: color-picker
components.title: Color picker
components.description: Choose a colour from preset swatches, the native colour control, or a hex value.
a11y: A group with an accessible name; each swatch is a button named by its hex value, with aria-pressed for the current colour.
The native colour input and the hex text field each have their own name.
The hex field sets aria-invalid and points to an error message with aria-describedby until the value is valid; colour is never the only signal because the hex text is always shown.

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox
components.description: Type to filter a list and pick one option.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox: the input has role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through options, Enter picks, Escape closes (and clears the typed text on a second press), Tab leaves.
Options are in a listbox with aria-selected; an empty result is announced as text.

components.name: command
components.title: Command
components.description: A searchable palette of actions that opens over the page, with an optional global shortcut.
a11y: A modal dialog named by a hidden title; focus moves to the search input and returns to the opener on close.
The input is an ARIA combobox controlling a listbox of grouped options; focus stays in the input and aria-activedescendant names the active option.
ArrowUp and ArrowDown move (skipping disabled items), Home and End jump, Enter runs the item, Escape closes.
The shortcut prop toggles the palette from anywhere (mod is Cmd on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere); result count is announced through a status region.

components.name: confetti
components.title: Confetti
components.description: A short burst of square confetti on a canvas, triggered by a prop or a ref method.
a11y: The canvas is aria-hidden and ignores the pointer, so it never blocks or announces anything.
Off under prefers-reduced-motion: no burst is drawn. Announce the event it celebrates in text as well.

components.name: container
components.title: Container
components.description: Centre content in a column with a sensible maximum width and side padding.
a11y: A plain div; adds no roles.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context menu
components.description: A menu of actions opened by right click or long press on an area.
a11y: Opens with right click, long press or the context-menu key (Shift+F10).
Arrow keys move, Enter or Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus.
Every action must also exist elsewhere in the UI for people who cannot open it.

components.name: copy-button
components.title: Copy button
components.description: A button that copies a value to the clipboard, shows 'Copied' for a moment and announces it.
a11y: Native button; the icon-only form is named by the label prop (default 'Copy').
The result is announced in a polite role=status region: 'Copied' or 'Copy failed'.
The text button changes its visible text to the copied label and resets itself.

components.name: data-grid
components.title: Data grid
components.description: A virtualised, keyboard-navigable grid for very large data sets, with sortable columns and row selection.
a11y: role="grid" with aria-rowcount, aria-colcount, aria-rowindex and aria-colindex so assistive technology knows the full size although only visible rows are in the DOM.
Roving tabindex: one Tab stop; arrow keys move between cells, Home and End go to the row ends, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End to the first and last cell, PageUp and PageDown move a screenful.
Sortable headers carry aria-sort (ascending, descending, none); Enter or Space on a focused header sorts.
With selectionMode, rows carry aria-selected and Space or a click toggles the focused row; the grid is aria-multiselectable in multiple mode.
The header row stays visible while scrolling; an empty grid shows an empty state.

components.name: data-table
components.title: Data table
components.description: A table with sortable columns, row selection and pagination.
a11y: Native table; sortable headers hold a real button and the th carries aria-sort (ascending, descending, none).
Each row and the select-all box are checkboxes with names; select-all shows the indeterminate state for a partial selection.
The count of selected rows is announced through a status region.
An empty result shows an empty state inside the table; pagination is a nav landmark of buttons.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date picker
components.description: A button that opens a calendar and shows the chosen date.
a11y: The trigger is a button naming the field and the current value; it opens a dialog with the calendar.
Choosing a date closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes without changing.
All calendar keyboard behaviour applies inside.

components.name: date-range-picker
components.title: Date range picker
components.description: A button that opens a range calendar and two typed date fields.
a11y: The trigger is a button naming the field and the current range; it opens a dialog with two text fields and the calendar.
Typed fields are labelled Start and End, accept YYYY-MM-DD, apply on Enter or blur and mark aria-invalid with an alert message when the text is not a pickable date.
Choosing the end date closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes without changing.
All range-calendar keyboard behaviour applies inside.

components.name: description-list
components.title: Description list
components.description: Label and value pairs, like the details of a record.
a11y: A native dl with dt and dd, so assistive tech pairs each label with its value.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal window for a question or short task that blocks the page.
a11y: role=dialog with aria-modal; the title names it and the description describes it.
Focus moves into the dialog, is trapped there, and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape and the Close button close it; the page behind is inert.

components.name: direction-provider
components.title: Direction provider
components.description: Sets the reading direction (ltr or rtl) once for every Radix-based component below it.
a11y: Arrow keys follow the reading direction: in rtl, ArrowLeft moves to the next tab, slider step up or toolbar item.
Pair it with a dir attribute on html so the stylesheet mirrors layout too.

components.name: dot-pattern
components.title: Dot pattern
components.description: A decorative dot grid background drawn in SVG with currentColor.
a11y: Decorative: aria-hidden and not focusable, so it adds nothing to the reading order.
Static; no motion.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: A panel that slides in from an edge for secondary tasks, details or navigation.
a11y: role="dialog" named by the title.
Focus is trapped while open and returns to the trigger on close.
Escape and the overlay close it.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown menu
components.description: A list of actions that opens from a button.
a11y: role=menu with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items.
Arrow keys move, Enter and Space activate, Escape closes and returns focus, type-ahead jumps to an item.
The trigger has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.

components.name: empty-state
components.title: Empty state
components.description: Say that there is nothing here yet and offer the next step.
a11y: Plain heading and text; put the action in children as a button or link.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: Connects a label, a control, a hint and an error with the right ids and ARIA.
a11y: The label is bound to the control by id, so it has an accessible name.
Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid and is announced via role=alert.
required sets the native required attribute on the control.

components.name: fieldset
components.title: Fieldset
components.description: Group related controls under one legend.
a11y: Native fieldset and legend: screen readers announce the legend with each control.
disabled on the fieldset disables every control inside.

components.name: file-upload
components.title: File upload
components.description: Choose files by browsing or dropping them, and see what is selected.
a11y: A native file input stays focusable and operable by keyboard; the drop zone is a label for it.
Selected files are listed as text with a Remove button each; changes are announced via a polite status.
Dragging is an extra, never the only way.

components.name: flex
components.title: Flex
components.description: A flex container with direction, wrap, align, justify, gap and an inline form. Stack covers the common case.
a11y: A plain element; adds no roles. Reversed directions change visual order only, so keep the source order meaningful.

components.name: form
components.title: Form
components.description: A form wrapper with a submit helper, an error summary that links to invalid fields, and an actions footer.
a11y: A native form; give it an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has several.
The error summary is a role=alert region at the top; each item is a link that moves focus to the invalid control.
Pass each message to its Field too, so the control carries aria-invalid and aria-describedby.

components.name: grid
components.title: Grid
components.description: A responsive grid of equal columns with one gap.
a11y: A plain div; source order is reading order.

components.name: grid-pattern
components.title: Grid pattern
components.description: A decorative line grid background drawn in SVG with currentColor.
a11y: Decorative: aria-hidden and not focusable, so it adds nothing to the reading order.
Static; no motion.

components.name: heading
components.title: Heading
components.description: A heading whose level (for structure) is separate from its size (for looks).
a11y: Renders a real h1 to h6; choose the level for the outline, not the size.

components.name: hover-card
components.title: Hover card
components.description: Preview extra content when a link or element is hovered or focused.
a11y: Opens on pointer hover and on keyboard focus of the trigger.
Supplementary only: never put the sole path to information or actions in it.
Not shown on touch devices; the trigger must work on its own.

components.name: icon-button
components.title: Icon button
components.description: A square button holding only an icon. The accessible name is required.
a11y: Native button; aria-label is required by the type.
Space and Enter activate it.

components.name: image
components.title: Image
components.description: An image with required alt text, a ratio, and a fallback when it fails to load.
a11y: alt is required; use alt="" only for purely decorative images.
The fallback shows the alt text so the content is not lost when loading fails.

components.name: image-gallery
components.title: Image gallery
components.description: A thumbnail grid that opens a lightbox with previous and next.
a11y: Each thumbnail is a button named by the image's required alt text, with aria-haspopup=dialog.
The lightbox is a modal dialog titled 'Image 2 of 5'; focus moves in, is trapped, and returns to the thumbnail on close.
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight (swapped in RTL) and the Previous and Next buttons move through the images and wrap; a horizontal swipe does the same; Escape closes.
A polite status message announces the new image's alt text and position. Neighbouring images are preloaded.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: A single-line text field.
a11y: Native <input>: all keyboard and autofill behaviour is the browser's.
Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically; invalid sets aria-invalid.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: Show a keyboard key or shortcut.
a11y: Native kbd element, announced as text.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: The visible name of a form control.
a11y: A real <label>: clicking it focuses the control it names.
required adds a visual marker; set required on the control for assistive tech.

components.name: line-chart
components.title: Line chart
components.description: Show how one or more values change across an ordered axis, with straight or stepped lines.
a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every value, one row per category, for screen readers.
One focusable stop per category with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus.
Series differ by dash pattern and marker shape as well as colour, and the legend names them.
No entrance animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: link
components.title: Link
components.description: An underlined link. External links open safely and say so.
a11y: A real anchor with a visible underline; focus ring shared with other controls.
External links get rel="noopener noreferrer" and a hidden "(opens in a new tab)".

components.name: marquee
components.title: Marquee
components.description: Scroll a row of items endlessly; pauses on hover and stops for reduced motion.
a11y: The duplicate copy is aria-hidden so screen readers read the items once.
Pauses on hover and focus; animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: mentions
components.title: Mentions
components.description: A textarea that suggests people when you type @.
a11y: The textarea keeps its native textbox role (ARIA does not allow combobox on a textarea) and adds aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-autocomplete="list", aria-controls while the list is open and aria-activedescendant for the highlighted option; the list is a listbox of options.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the highlight, Enter or Tab insert the mention, Escape closes the list without inserting; focus never leaves the textarea.
A polite status region announces how many suggestions there are, and when they are loading or empty.
Async loading ignores answers for outdated queries so the list never shows stale results.

components.name: menubar
components.title: Menubar
components.description: A horizontal bar of menus, like File, Edit and View in a desktop app.
a11y: role="menubar"; arrow keys move between menus and items, Enter or Space opens.
Escape closes the open menu and returns focus to its trigger.

components.name: multi-select
components.title: Multi select
components.description: Type to filter a list and pick several options, shown as removable tags.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox with a listbox that has aria-multiselectable; options carry aria-selected.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move, Enter toggles the active option, Escape closes, Tab leaves.
Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag; each tag has a button named "Remove <label>".

components.name: native-select
components.title: Native select
components.description: The browser select, styled. Best on mobile and for long simple lists.
a11y: A real select element: native keyboard, typeahead and mobile pickers.
Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.title: Navigation menu
components.description: Site navigation with links and menus that open panels of links.
a11y: A nav landmark with a list of links and menu buttons.
Arrow keys move between top-level items; Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens a panel; Escape closes it.
The current page link has aria-current="page".

components.name: notification-center
components.title: Notification center
components.description: A bell button with an unread count that opens a list of notifications, with mark read, clear and an empty state.
a11y: The bell is a button named 'Notifications, 3 unread'; the visible count badge is aria-hidden so the number is announced once.
The panel is a labelled dialog: Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the bell.
Unread items are bold, start with a visually hidden 'Unread:' and have a 'Mark read' button named after the item; unread is never shown by colour alone.
'Mark all read' and 'Clear all' are disabled when they have nothing to do; an empty list shows plain text.

components.name: number-input
components.title: Number input
components.description: A numeric field with decrease and increase buttons.
a11y: Native input type="number"; ArrowUp/ArrowDown change the value.
The step buttons are named "Decrease" and "Increase" and are skipped by Tab.

components.name: number-ticker
components.title: Number ticker
components.description: Count up to a number when it scrolls into view. Shows the final value at once for reduced motion.
a11y: Screen readers get the final number from an sr-only copy; the animated frames are aria-hidden.
With prefers-reduced-motion the final number shows immediately and nothing animates.

components.name: orbiting-circles
components.title: Orbiting circles
components.description: Small items circling a centre. Decorative.
a11y: Decorative: the whole element is aria-hidden, so nothing inside it is read or reachable by assistive tech.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the items stop, evenly spaced around the ring.

components.name: otp-input
components.title: OTP input
components.description: Enter a one-time code, one digit per box, with paste support.
a11y: The boxes are a group with a name; each box is labelled "Digit N of M".
Typing moves forward, Backspace moves back, arrows move, pasting fills all boxes.
inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="one-time-code" for mobile and autofill.

components.name: overflow-list
components.title: Overflow list
components.description: A row of items that shows as many as fit and puts the rest in a '+N' menu.
a11y: Items that do not fit are visibility:hidden, so they are neither focusable nor read out; the same items are reachable in the menu.
The '+N' button is named '3 more items' (customisable with moreLabel) and opens a menu: Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens, arrows move, Escape closes and returns focus to the button.
Layout is recalculated by a ResizeObserver when the container or the items change.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: Move between pages of results.
a11y: A nav landmark; each page is a button named "Page N" and the current one has aria-current=page.
Prev and Next are disabled at the ends.
The gap marker is hidden from assistive tech.

components.name: password-input
components.title: Password input
components.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle.
a11y: The toggle is a button with aria-pressed named "Show password".
The field keeps autocomplete hints so password managers work.

components.name: pie-chart
components.title: Pie chart
components.description: Parts of a whole as a pie, or a donut with innerRadius.
a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every slice with its value and share.
One focusable stop per slice with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus.
Slices differ by fill pattern as well as colour, and the legend lists each with its value and share.
No entrance animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A floating panel of content or controls anchored to a button.
a11y: The trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is role=dialog.
Focus moves into the panel; Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: How far along a task is, or that it is still working.
a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
Indeterminate omits aria-valuenow.
aria-label is required.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio group
components.description: Pick exactly one option from a short list.
a11y: role=radiogroup with role=radio items; one Tab stop for the group.
Arrow keys move and select; Space selects the focused item.
Give the group an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

components.name: range-calendar
components.title: Range calendar
components.description: A month grid for picking a start and an end date.
a11y: role="grid" with column headers; one day is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
Enter or Space on a day sets the start, then the end; Escape while picking clears the start.
Arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the start and end of the week, PageUp/PageDown by month; arrows are mirrored in right-to-left.
The days between start and focus are previewed while picking, by hover and by keyboard.
Each day button has a full date name; start and end have aria-pressed; a status region announces the chosen range.
Disabled days (min, max, isDateDisabled) are real disabled buttons.

components.name: rating
components.title: Rating
components.description: Pick or show a score from 1 to a maximum, as stars.
a11y: Editable: a radio group (native radios) with arrow-key selection; each star is named "N of M".
Read-only: role="img" with a text label such as "4 out of 5".

components.name: resizable
components.title: Resizable
components.description: Panels separated by handles you drag or move with the keyboard.
a11y: Each handle is a focusable role="separator" with aria-orientation, aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-controls pointing at the panel it resizes.
Arrow keys resize by the step (horizontal groups use Left/Right, vertical groups Up/Down; mirrored in right-to-left); PageUp/PageDown resize by double; Home and End jump to the limits.
minSize and maxSize are enforced for both keyboard and pointer, and are reflected in aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
Handles are at least 24 CSS px to grab and show the focus ring.

components.name: rich-text-editor
components.title: Rich text editor
components.description: A dependency-free rich text editor with a formatting toolbar and sanitized HTML in and out.
a11y: The editing region has role="textbox", aria-multiline and an accessible name; the toolbar is a named toolbar with one tab stop and arrow-key movement.
Toggle buttons (bold, italic, underline, lists, headings, quote) carry aria-pressed that follows the selection.
Cmd/Ctrl+B, I, U and K apply bold, italic, underline and open the link prompt; Escape in the toolbar returns focus to the editor.
The link prompt is a labelled popover; an invalid address is announced as an alert and links are limited to http, https and mailto.
Pasted content is sanitized to a small tag allowlist; disabled and read-only set aria-disabled and aria-readonly and turn the toolbar off.

components.name: rolling-number
components.title: Rolling number
components.description: A number whose digits roll to the new value when it changes. Screen readers read the final value.
a11y: The animated digits are aria-hidden; the formatted final value is plain text for screen readers.
With prefers-reduced-motion the digits change without rolling.
Not interactive: no focus stops.

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll area
components.description: A scrollable region with thin, themed scrollbars.
a11y: The viewport is focusable (tabindex 0) so keyboard users can scroll it; give it an aria-label when it holds standalone content.
Native scrolling semantics are preserved.

components.name: scroll-progress
components.title: Scroll progress
components.description: A thin bar fixed to the top of the window that fills as the page scrolls.
a11y: Decorative and aria-hidden by default.
With `label` it is a progressbar with aria-valuenow from 0 to 100, updated as the page scrolls.
No transition, so there is no motion beyond the scroll itself.

components.name: segmented-control
components.title: Segmented control
components.description: Pick exactly one option from a short row, shown as joined segments.
a11y: A named radio group; arrow keys move and select, Home and End jump.
One option is always selected: pressing the active one does nothing.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: Pick one value from a list of five or more options.
a11y: Trigger is role=combobox with aria-expanded; the list is role=listbox with option items.
Arrow keys, Home, End and type-ahead move; Enter selects; Escape closes.
Inside a Field it is labelled by the Field's label.

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: A thin rule between groups.
a11y: Decorative by default: role=none so screen readers skip it.
With decorative=false it is role=separator with aria-orientation.

components.name: shimmer-button
components.title: Shimmer button
components.description: The Button with a light sweep across it. Still a native button.
a11y: Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses; behaviour comes from Button.
The sweep is a pseudo-element, never read aloud, and is off under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: A still placeholder shaped like the content that is loading.
a11y: aria-hidden: it carries no information.
Pair with an aria-busy region or a Spinner so loading is announced once.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: Pick a number, or a range, by dragging or with the keyboard.
a11y: Each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuenow, min and max.
Arrow keys step; Home and End jump to the ends; PageUp and PageDown take larger steps.
aria-label is required; a range labels its thumbs minimum and maximum.

components.name: sortable-list
components.title: Sortable list
components.description: A list the user reorders by dragging a handle or with the keyboard, with live announcements.
a11y: Each row has a handle button named 'Reorder <item>' with aria-pressed while picked up and a description of the keys.
Space or Enter picks an item up; the arrow keys (or Home and End) move it; Space or Enter drops it; Escape cancels and restores the order; Tab cancels.
A polite live region announces: picked up, moved to position N of M, dropped, cancelled.
Pointer drag uses the same handle; reordering never depends on dragging alone.

components.name: sparkline
components.title: Sparkline
components.description: A tiny inline trend line for a table cell or a sentence.
a11y: role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table (table roles on spans, valid inside a paragraph) lists every value for screen readers.
Decorative at a glance: it has no tooltip and no tab stops.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: A small indicator that something is loading.
a11y: role=status with an aria-label; polite, not interrupting.
Animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: spotlight
components.title: Spotlight
components.description: A surface with a soft highlight that follows the pointer.
a11y: Pointer only and purely visual: no keyboard behaviour depends on it, and the glow is a pseudo-element that is never read aloud.
Content keeps its normal order and focus ring; the glow only appears for hover-capable pointers.
No fade transition under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: stack
components.title: Stack
components.description: Lay children out in a column or row with one gap from the spacing scale.
a11y: A plain div; adds no roles.

components.name: stat
components.title: Stat
components.description: One number with its label and a note.
a11y: A description list (dl) pairs the label with its value.

components.name: stepper
components.title: Stepper
components.description: Show progress through a numbered sequence of steps.
a11y: An ordered list; the current step has aria-current="step".
Completed steps are marked in text for assistive tech, not by colour alone.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.
a11y: role=switch with aria-checked; Space and Enter toggle.
A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: Rows and columns of data with a header, in a horizontally scrolling wrapper.
a11y: Native table elements with th scope and an optional caption.
The scroll wrapper is focusable and named so keyboard users can scroll wide tables.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: Switch between related views in the same place.
a11y: role=tablist, tab and tabpanel with aria-selected and aria-controls.
Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump; only the active tab is a Tab stop.
Give the list an accessible name with aria-label.

components.name: tag
components.title: Tag
components.description: A short label, optionally removable.
a11y: The remove control is a real button named "Remove <label>".

components.name: tags-input
components.title: Tags input
components.description: Type text and press Enter or comma to add it as a removable tag.
a11y: A native text input; Enter or comma adds the tag, and leaving the field adds pending text.
Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag.
Each tag has a button named "Remove <tag>"; the field takes its name from a label or aria-label.

components.name: text
components.title: Text
components.description: Body text with a size and tone from the scale.
a11y: A plain p (or the child with asChild); tone is never the only signal, so pair danger text with words.

components.name: text-reveal
components.title: Text reveal
components.description: Fade a sentence in word by word. Static for reduced motion.
a11y: The text stays real text in reading order; nothing is hidden from assistive tech.
With prefers-reduced-motion every word is visible at once.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text field.
a11y: Native <textarea>.
Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically; invalid sets aria-invalid.

components.name: time-field
components.title: Time field
components.description: Hour, minute and AM/PM segments you step with arrow keys or type into.
a11y: A named group of spin buttons (Hour, Minute, AM or PM), each with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown step a segment (minutes by the step prop), PageUp/PageDown step further, Home/End jump to the limits, Backspace clears.
Typing digits fills a segment and moves to the next; A and P set AM and PM.
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between segments and are mirrored in right-to-left.

components.name: time-picker
components.title: Time picker
components.description: Pick a time of day with hour, minute and AM/PM segments, using the browser's own control.
a11y: Native input type="time": the browser exposes hour, minute and AM/PM as spinbuttons.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown change a segment, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight or Tab move between segments, typing digits fills one.
The control takes its name from a label or aria-label; min, max and step are passed through.

components.name: timeline
components.title: Timeline
components.description: A vertical list of events with times, joined by a rule.
a11y: An ordered list of events; the time is a real time element when a datetime is given.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: A short message that appears briefly and does not block the page.
a11y: Announced politely by assistive tech without moving focus.
Pauses its timer on hover and focus; F8 jumps focus to the toast region.
Never the only place a critical result appears; keep an inline message too.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed or not.
a11y: A button with aria-pressed; Space and Enter toggle it.
Icon-only toggles need an aria-label.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle group
components.description: A row of toggles where one or several can be on.
a11y: single type is role=radiogroup with radio items; multiple type is a group of toggle buttons.
Arrow keys move focus between items; Space and Enter toggle.
Give the group an aria-label.

components.name: toolbar
components.title: Toolbar
components.description: A row of related controls that share one tab stop and arrow-key movement.
a11y: role="toolbar" with a required name; one Tab stop, arrow keys move between controls.
Home and End jump to the first and last control.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: Short hint text on hover and keyboard focus.
a11y: Shows on hover and on keyboard focus; the trigger gets aria-describedby while it is open.
Escape dismisses it; it stays open while the pointer is over it.
Never the only place for essential information: touch users do not get hover.

components.name: tour
components.title: Tour
components.description: A guided walkthrough: a spotlight on one element at a time with a card and Next, Back and Skip.
a11y: The step card is a dialog named by its title and described by its text; it takes focus on every step.
Tab stays inside the card; Escape ends the tour and focus returns to where it was.
ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move between steps when the card has focus (mirrored in right-to-left).
Each step is announced politely as "Step n of m"; the highlighted element scrolls into view.
The overlay and spotlight are hidden from assistive technology; animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: tree
components.title: Tree
components.description: A nested list of items that open and close, with one selected item.
a11y: role=tree with treeitem children and role=group for branches; aria-expanded on branches, aria-selected on every item, aria-level on each.
Roving tabindex: one item is in the tab order; Tab enters and leaves the tree as one stop.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown move, ArrowRight opens a branch then enters it, ArrowLeft closes it then goes to the parent, Home and End jump.
Enter or Space selects; typing letters jumps to the next label that starts with them. The tree needs an aria-label.

components.name: tree-select
components.title: Tree select
components.description: A select whose options are a nested tree, with search and single or multiple selection.
a11y: An input with role=combobox, aria-haspopup=tree and aria-activedescendant; focus never leaves the input.
The popup is role=tree: each treeitem has aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-selected and (for branches) aria-expanded; aria-multiselectable in multiple mode.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp open the list and move; ArrowRight opens a branch then enters it; ArrowLeft closes it then goes to the parent (swapped in RTL); Enter selects or toggles; Escape closes.
Typing filters the tree to matching nodes and their parents, opened automatically; an empty result shows text.
Selection is shown in the input as text ('A, B' or '3 selected') and a check mark, not colour.

components.name: typewriter
components.title: Typewriter
components.description: Type a string one character at a time. Static for reduced motion.
a11y: Screen readers get the full text at once from an sr-only copy; the typed characters are aria-hidden.
With prefers-reduced-motion the full text shows immediately and the caret does not blink.

components.name: virtual-list
components.title: Virtual list
components.description: A windowed list for thousands of rows: only the rows in view are in the page.
a11y: role=list with listitem rows; every row carries aria-posinset and aria-setsize so the position in the full list is announced.
Roving tabindex: one row is in the tab order. ArrowUp/ArrowDown, PageUp/PageDown, Home and End move focus and scroll the row into view.
The list needs an aria-label.

components.name: use-click-outside
components.title: useClickOutside
components.description: Calls a function when a pointer goes down outside an element, to close menus and popovers.
a11y: No DOM output. Close popovers with Escape too; this hook covers pointer only.
Listens to pointerdown on the document and removes the listener on unmount.

components.name: use-clipboard
components.title: useClipboard
components.description: Copy text with the Clipboard API, with a copied flag that resets after a delay and an error when it fails.
a11y: No DOM output. Pair the copied state with a visible or aria-live status message in the UI.
A failed copy returns false and sets error; it never throws.

components.name: use-controllable-state
components.title: useControllableState
components.description: The value, defaultValue and onChange pattern for custom components that can be controlled or uncontrolled.
a11y: No DOM output. Lets a custom widget accept value/defaultValue/onValueChange like the Monoline components do.
onChange fires only when the new value differs from the current one.

components.name: use-counter
components.title: useCounter
components.description: A number with increment, decrement, set and reset, bounded by optional min and max.
a11y: No DOM output.

components.name: use-debounce
components.title: useDebounce
components.description: Debounced value and debounced callback: wait for input to settle before acting.
a11y: No DOM output. Use for search fields so the list updates after typing stops.
A pending callback is dropped on unmount.

components.name: use-disclosure
components.title: useDisclosure
components.description: Open and closed state with open, close and toggle functions, and callbacks when it changes.
a11y: No DOM output. Pair with aria-expanded and aria-controls on the trigger.
Callbacks run only when the state actually changes, not on mount.

components.name: use-document-title
components.title: useDocumentTitle
components.description: Set document.title while a component is mounted, then restore it.
a11y: Sets the page title, which screen readers announce on navigation. Make each view title unique and meaningful.

components.name: use-focus-trap
components.title: useFocusTrap
components.description: Keeps Tab focus inside an element while it is active, and returns focus when it closes.
a11y: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the container while active. Focus moves in on activation.
Focus returns to the element that had it before when the trap ends. Escape to close is the caller's job.

components.name: use-hash
components.title: useHash
components.description: Read and set location.hash as state.
a11y: No DOM output. Changing the hash adds a history entry, so Back works.

components.name: use-hotkeys
components.title: useHotkeys
components.description: Keyboard shortcuts such as mod+k or escape, ignored while typing in fields unless allowed.
a11y: No DOM output. Shortcuts are additions: every control must still be reachable by keyboard and Tab.
mod means Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere. Typing in inputs is ignored unless allowInInputs is set.

components.name: use-hover
components.title: useHover
components.description: Track whether the pointer is over an element.
a11y: No DOM output. Hover is pointer-only: never hide essential content or actions behind it.

components.name: use-intersection
components.title: useIntersection
components.description: Know whether an element is in view, with an IntersectionObserver.
a11y: No DOM output. When IntersectionObserver is unavailable, it reports not intersecting.

components.name: use-interval
components.title: useInterval
components.description: Calls a function on a timer, with a null delay to pause it. Cleared on unmount.
a11y: No DOM output. Clears its timer on unmount so nothing runs after the component is gone.
Pass null as the delay to pause.

components.name: use-local-storage
components.title: useLocalStorage
components.description: A JSON value kept in localStorage, shaped like useState, that stays in sync across tabs.
a11y: No DOM output. Storage failures (blocked, full) fall back to memory and do not throw.
Other tabs receive changes through the storage event.

components.name: use-long-press
components.title: useLongPress
components.description: Call a handler when an element is held down, cancelling if the pointer moves or lifts early.
a11y: Press and hold is hard for many people: always offer a normal click or keyboard action for the same result.

components.name: use-media-query
components.title: useMediaQuery
components.description: Whether a CSS media query matches, updated live, and safe to render on the server.
a11y: No DOM output. The first render returns defaultValue so server and client markup match.
Listens to matchMedia changes and removes the listener on unmount.

components.name: use-mounted
components.title: useMounted
components.description: True after the first client render. Use it to avoid server and client markup differences.
a11y: No DOM output.

components.name: use-previous
components.title: usePrevious
components.description: The value from the previous render, for comparing a change.
a11y: No DOM output.

components.name: use-reduced-motion
components.title: useReducedMotion
components.description: Whether the user has asked the system to reduce motion, for skipping or simplifying animation in code.
a11y: No DOM output. CSS already disables animation under prefers-reduced-motion; use this for JS-driven motion.

components.name: use-scroll-spy
components.title: useScrollSpy
components.description: Find which section is currently in view, for a table of contents or sticky nav.
a11y: No DOM output. Highlight the active link and keep real links so keyboard and no-JS users can navigate.

components.name: use-timeout
components.title: useTimeout
components.description: Run a callback after a delay, with start and clear controls.
a11y: No DOM output.

components.name: use-toggle
components.title: useToggle
components.description: Cycle through a list of values, or flip a boolean.
a11y: No DOM output.

components.name: use-window-event
components.title: useWindowEvent
components.description: Add a typed window event listener that is removed on unmount.
a11y: No DOM output.
